message.content: We need to decide how MemoryMCP authenticates HTTP clients.

content.text: Two options: forward the Core API key from the client, or keep Core credentials server-side and map opaque bearer tokens to principal bindings.

message.content: Never let a client hold the Core key.

content.text: Agreed. TDAI_MCP_BINDINGS maps bearer token -> {teamId, agentId, userId}; the Core API key stays in the server process only.

message.content: Also: from now on, always run typecheck before you report a task done.

content.text: Noted, I will run npm run typecheck and npm test before reporting done.
